# ISummerGovernor
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/interfaces/ISummerGovernor.sol)

**Inherits:**
IGovernor, [ISummerGovernorErrors](../errors/i-summer-governor-errors.md)

**Title:**
ISummerGovernor Interface

Interface for the SummerGovernor contract, extending OpenZeppelin's IGovernor


## Functions
### castVote

Casts a vote for a proposal


```solidity
function castVote(uint256 proposalId, uint8 support) external returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`proposalId`|`uint256`|The ID of the proposal to vote on|
|`support`|`uint8`|The support for the proposal (0 = against, 1 = for, 2 = abstain)|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The proposal ID|


### propose

Proposes a new governance action


```solidity
function propose(
    address[] memory targets,
    uint256[] memory values,
    bytes[] memory calldatas,
    string memory description
)
    external
    override(IGovernor)
    returns (uint256 proposalId);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targets`|`address[]`|The addresses of the contracts to call|
|`values`|`uint256[]`|The ETH values to send with the calls|
|`calldatas`|`bytes[]`|The call data for each contract call|
|`description`|`string`|A description of the proposal|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`proposalId`|`uint256`|The ID of the newly created proposal|


### execute

Executes a proposal. Only callable on the proposal chain

Crosschain proposals are executed using LayerZero. Check _lzReceive for the execution logic


```solidity
function execute(
    address[] memory targets,
    uint256[] memory values,
    bytes[] memory calldatas,
    bytes32 descriptionHash
)
    external
    payable
    override(IGovernor)
    returns (uint256 proposalId);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targets`|`address[]`|The addresses of the contracts to call|
|`values`|`uint256[]`|The ETH values to send with the calls|
|`calldatas`|`bytes[]`|The call data for each contract call|
|`descriptionHash`|`bytes32`|The hash of the proposal description|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`proposalId`|`uint256`|The ID of the executed proposal|


### cancel

Cancels an existing proposal


```solidity
function cancel(
    address[] memory targets,
    uint256[] memory values,
    bytes[] memory calldatas,
    bytes32 descriptionHash
)
    external
    override(IGovernor)
    returns (uint256 proposalId);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targets`|`address[]`|The addresses of the contracts to call|
|`values`|`uint256[]`|The ETH values to send with the calls|
|`calldatas`|`bytes[]`|The call data for each contract call|
|`descriptionHash`|`bytes32`|The hash of the proposal description|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`proposalId`|`uint256`|The ID of the cancelled proposal|


### sendProposalToTargetChain

Sends a proposal to another chain for execution


```solidity
function sendProposalToTargetChain(
    uint32 _dstEid,
    address[] memory _dstTargets,
    uint256[] memory _dstValues,
    bytes[] memory _dstCalldatas,
    bytes32 _dstDescriptionHash,
    bytes calldata _options
)
    external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_dstEid`|`uint32`|The destination Endpoint ID|
|`_dstTargets`|`address[]`|The target addresses for the proposal|
|`_dstValues`|`uint256[]`|The values for the proposal|
|`_dstCalldatas`|`bytes[]`|The calldata for the proposal|
|`_dstDescriptionHash`|`bytes32`|The description hash for the proposal|
|`_options`|`bytes`|Message execution options|


### isActiveGuardian

Checks if an account is an active guardian for governance purposes

Delegates check to ProtocolAccessManager


```solidity
function isActiveGuardian(address account) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`account`|`address`|The address to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|bool True if the account is an active guardian, false otherwise|


## Events
### ProposalSentCrossChain
Emitted when a proposal is sent cross-chain


```solidity
event ProposalSentCrossChain(uint256 indexed proposalId, uint32 indexed dstEid);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`proposalId`|`uint256`|The ID of the proposal|
|`dstEid`|`uint32`|The destination endpoint ID|

### ProposalReceivedCrossChain
Emitted when a proposal is received cross-chain


```solidity
event ProposalReceivedCrossChain(uint256 indexed proposalId, uint32 indexed srcEid);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`proposalId`|`uint256`|The ID of the proposal|
|`srcEid`|`uint32`|The source endpoint ID|
